decisions.reason: The existing message 114 MODIFY already updates the accent's derivation source to the selected Option 2 Hero V geometry; no additional update or removal is required.
The existing message 114 MODIFY already captures that the second V's terminal gesture derives from the selected Option 2 Hero V termination.
The shared terminal treatment is already established by its message 114 INTRODUCE, including its cross-glyph role, intended ending, and refinement constraints.
The source changes the selected Hero V direction and shared terminal gesture, not the deferred architecture of the E and L letterforms.
Selecting Option 2 and refining its terminal does not change the second V's smaller, subordinate visual prominence.
The client's appreciation of the collaborative discussion does not modify the task-local requirement to include design rationale with each review round.
The Hero V selection and terminal refinement do not alter the deferred full-wordmark kerning requirement.
The source concerns black-and-white glyph geometry and does not resume or modify the deferred champagne material treatment.
